trigger: Player reported that the game was not fun and the scene did not change.
changes: Replace the static bitmap scene in the active game with state-driven SVG landscapes for wind, estuary and reef missions.
Replace three one-click news demonstrations with three budget-constrained rescue simulations, each with three visible goals and a second-move event.
Render infrastructure, grid delivery, village lights, runoff, meadow growth, monitoring buoys, reef protection and persistent heat stress.
Keep each assessment deployment on screen until the player continues, instead of advancing after 550 ms.
Respect reduced-motion preferences by default; provide an explicit motion toggle. Final visual states remain visible without animation.

research.score: 0–3 per variable per phase; change equals post minus pre; incomplete measures remain null.
research.process_events: training[] stores ordered lesson/action/at/elapsedMs. These are exposure records, not a fourth primary outcome.
research.comparability: Do not pool v3 and v4 as the same intervention. The learning experience and assessment visuals changed.
research.limits: The rubric and parallel forms are not validated. Deployment visuals may cue subsequent decisions; pilot this effect. Repeated option labels may permit recall. No evidence of enjoyment or causal learning gains is claimed.
research.motion_context: Session reducedMotion records the operating-system preference at session start; the optional UI toggle is not a psychometric measure.
research.simulation: Budget points and environmental changes are educational illustrations, not calibrated costs, climate predictions or verified carbon credits. Reef heat persists after local protection.

verification.automated: 17 behavior/simulation/receiver tests pass, including exhaustive reachable rescue states, spending failure, immutable training records, 600-second boundaries, scoring and partial records. HTTP checks and TypeScript pass.
verification.browser: TEST_ISLAND_V4 completed 27 decisions and 11 training moves across three rescue missions. Pre scores 2/1/1, post1 and post2 3/3/3; differences +1/+2/+2. Resume preserved training state and deadline. Full English scene and UI had no Han text. Mobile clientWidth and scrollWidth both 375. Motion-on wind rotor computed rotation changed from 19.3019deg to 230.553deg.
verification.interpretation: Functional and visual verification only; real-player enjoyment and completion time require playtesting.

google_sheets.note: Live Google write verification remains pending researcher configuration. Demo records remain local.
